claims.text: POL-RD-01 establishes a route deviation when the excess of actual over optimal distance exceeds BOTH 20% of the optimal route AND 0.8 km in absolute terms. The platform's derived facts on this trip's 100%-coverage GPS trace put the excess at 6.18 km — 29.43% of the 21.0 km optimal route — so both gates pass and a deviation is ESTABLISHED on this trip's own evidence.

POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure govern and forbids citing the trip record's rounded copy for the threshold test. The trace's own trace_distance_km is 27.18 km against a 21.0 km optimal route, and the trip record's rounded 27.2 km convenience copy agrees with it, so the measured deviation is not an artefact of rounding.

The deviation is admitted, not merely inferred from the trace. After the rider asked why the car was heading toward the city centre, the driver wrote in the platform chat at 10:42:05 'sorry boss missed the exit, coming back now', and his counterparty statement repeats 'I took a wrong turn at the MCE exit and had to come back around'. That is an on-record driver admission of the excess distance.

Under POL-RD-08 the rider carries the initial burden and discharges it by showing (a) that trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry the same trip identifier TRP-00101 and (b) an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold measured from an unimpaired trace. Both are shown. The burden therefore shifts to the driver, and the driver has pointed to no artifact and no clause.

POL-RD-03 exonerates a deviation only where a traffic_advisory names a road the optimal route traverses within a matching validity window. The bundle's only advisory artifact, EV-ADVIS-00101-01, is MISSING — issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0; no LTA advisory was issued for the AYE/MCE/ECP corridor in the 10:14–10:59 window — so the three-limb test cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the driver's 'missed the exit' explanation excused nothing under POL-RD-13.

POL-RD-04 exonerates only a detour the rider asked for, corroborated by the trace passing within 200 m of chat_message.waypoint_hint. The rider's only messages on this trip are route complaints; there is no rider instruction to detour, and every waypoint_hint is null, so the corroboration test cannot be run and POL-RD-04 excludes no distance from the excess.

Neither POL-RD-05 nor POL-RD-12 applies. The trip record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at null with amended_optimal_distance_km null, so there is no relocated endpoint to re-quote against; and the vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so the correct baseline is the solo optimal of 21.0 km against which the trace was measured.

POL-RD-08's enhanced-corroboration condition is not triggered. The rider profile records deviation_claims_60d of 0 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated of 0, far below the 4-claim threshold the clause names, so no corroboration beyond the trace is required to prove a claim of this size.

Under POL-RD-02 the refund on this METERED fare is arithmetic, not discretionary. With surge_multiplier read from the fare breakdown at 1.0, recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75×21.0 + 0.28×26.0) × 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee = 27.63. charged_total is 35.64, so the refund is 35.64 − 27.63 = 8.01, rounded up to SGD 8.05 — above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and below 90% of charged_total, so the rider's remedy is a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 8.05.

No POL-RD-10 escalation trigger fires, so this case is decided on the money and not sent to a human with the sum frozen. The trace is unimpaired — 100% coverage, no gaps, 10 s sampling, so POL-RD-07(a) to (c) are not met; the trip identifiers all match; and no party has cited the missing advisory, so under POL-RD-13(1) the absent artifact EV-ADVIS-00101-01 (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0) is a gap in the bundle no one invoked, not a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction.

claims.text: The measured excess on this trip is 6.18 km, which is 29.43% of the 21.0 km optimal route (trace distance 27.18 km less optimal 21.0 km). Under POL-RD-01 a deviation is additionally MATERIAL only where the excess exceeds 50% of the optimal distance or exceeds 8.0 km absolute; at 29.43% and 6.18 km neither limb is met. The deviation is therefore established but NOT material, so the remedy is confined to the arithmetic under POL-RD-02 and no full-refund uplift or conduct referral under POL-RD-06 can be triggered by this trip.

Even if the materiality gate were reached and the driver_profile were consulted under POL-RD-06, no repeat-deviation pattern is established on the two fields that clause names: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 812, a ratio of 0.00, below the 0.05 threshold, and 0 is below the count of 3. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is not the trailing-90-day field POL-RD-06 asks for and is not used here. Neither the POL-RD-06(b) full-refund uplift nor the POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral follows.

If any refund issues it is arithmetic under POL-RD-02, not the sum the rider asks for. recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 21.0 + 0.28 x 26.0) x 1.0 surge + 0.80 platform fee = 27.63, and the refund is charged_total 35.64 less 27.63 = 8.01, rounded up to 8.05. That is 22.47% of the amount charged, far below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND of 8.05 and cannot be the $10.00 contested.

No pass-through correction can be added on top of any distance refund under POL-RD-09: erp_gantries is empty, tolls_erp is 0.00 and the derived erp_lines total is 0.00, and the airport surcharge is 0.00 on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport. There is accordingly no off-route ERP to refund and no unmatched or phantom gantry line refundable under POL-RD-09(4).

Runner-and-driver agree on that much, and the trace figure governs under POL-RD-01: the excess is 6.18 km, 29.4% of the optimal route, clearing both establishment gates (over 20% and over 0.8 km). It does NOT clear the materiality gates (over 50%, or over 8.0 km), so the deviation is established but not material, the remedy is confined to the POL-RD-02 arithmetic, and no POL-RD-06 full-refund uplift or conduct referral follows. The driver's own chat message at 10:42:05 ('sorry boss missed the exit, coming back now') and his counterparty statement ('I took a wrong turn at the MCE exit') admit the excess — they confirm the deviation, they do not excuse it. No exoneration applies: the rider asked for no detour (POL-RD-04 — the only rider messages are route complaints, every waypoint_hint is null, so the corroboration test cannot be run and no distance is excluded), no pickup or dropoff was amended (POL-RD-05), and the vehicle is RYDE_X, not pooled (POL-RD-12). The bundle's only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-00101-01, is MISSING (issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0); no LTA advisory existed for the AYE/MCE/ECP corridor in the trip window, so POL-RD-03's three-limb test cannot be run and the missed exit is a driver error, not an external traffic cause. On POL-RD-13: no party cited the absent advisory as an exculpatory artifact, so this is a gap in the bundle rather than a POL-RD-10(5) contradiction and there is no escalation. On the money, read from EV-FARE-00101 (METERED, charged_total 35.64): recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 × 21.0 km + 0.28 × 26.0 min) × 1.0 surge multiplier + 0.80 platform fee = 27.63. Refund = 35.64 − 27.63 = 8.01, rounded up to SGD 8.05. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and far below 90% of the charge, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 8.05, not the $10.00 claimed. There is nothing to pass through under POL-RD-09: erp_gantries is empty, tolls_erp is 0.00 and the airport surcharge is 0.00, so no off-route or phantom line is refundable. The rider's profile (deviation_claims_60d = 0) does not trigger enhanced corroboration. Confidence is capped at 1.0, the weight of the artifacts carrying the deciding facts — the trace (EV-GPS-00101) and the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-00101), both 1.0. One procedural note: the monetary effect of SGD 8.05 exceeds the SGD 8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05), so the ruling issues but execution is held for human release; this does not change the ruling value.
